commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Andoni Gorosabel as he is replaced by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao).
89' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
89' Nico Williams will be replaced by Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao).
87' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
85' Vicente Moreno has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) replacing Aimar Oroz.
84' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Osasuna will take a free kick near the side line.
79' Substitution. Ruben Garcia makes his way off the pitch and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes on as his replacement.
78' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
74' 1 - 2 What a hit! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
73' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) is caught offside!
69' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
68' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
67' Here is a change. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
66' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
66' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' None of the Ath Bilbao players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

64' Great first touch by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) after collecting a pass deep into the box. He smashes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a fantastic reflex save and pushes it onto the bar. Brilliant goalkeeping! The linesman points to the corner flag, Ath Bilbao are going to take it.
62' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
57' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is flagged for offside.
57' Vicente Moreno is forced to make a change. Juan Cruz is unable to continue due to injury, Abel Bretones (Osasuna) comes on.
57' The substitution has been made. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) has replaced Kike Barja.
55' The game is interrupted now, Juan Cruz (Osasuna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
55' It looks like Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Quintero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Ath Bilbao have a free kick.
52' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
51' The free kick from long range, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Ath Bilbao force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
50' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick.
48' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Alex Berenguer.
47' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jon Moncayola.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

42' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Quintero with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Ath Bilbao, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

40' Excellent touch by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
39' A cross from a corner kick by Osasuna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

39' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon is well positioned and easily deals with the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Osasuna.
38' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
37' Osasuna take a short corner kick.
37' Kike Barja (Osasuna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Osasuna.
37' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is able to continue to play.
35' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) brings an opponent down and Alejandro Quintero interrupts the game. Osasuna get a free kick.

31' 1 - 1 Inaki Williams showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 1:1.
28' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Osasuna.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Torro (Osasuna) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
25' The free kick from long range, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
23' The Ath Bilbao players can’t believe it after referee Alejandro Quintero signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
22' Referee Alejandro Quintero makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Ath Bilbao. Let’s see what happens!
20' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
20' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the right post as the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
19' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.

16' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Sergio Herrera was alert and the score remains the same.

10' A long pass finds Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.

9' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom left corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
8' An attempted cross from Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
7' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Sergio Herrera.
6' Wasted opportunity. Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
6' Kike Barja (Osasuna) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
4' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Alejandro Quintero is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
